author: TEDx Talks
description:
Is Las Vegas secretly one of America’s greatest art cities? In this witty and illuminating talk, museum leader Aaron Berger takes us on a whirlwind tour of high-end masterpieces hiding in plain sight - in lobbies, lounges, and even bars on the Las Vegas Strip. From Chihuly’s glass ceiling at the Bellagio to Damien Hirst’s infamous shark at the Palms, Berger challenges our ideas of where art belongs, and who it’s for.

Through personal anecdotes, cultural critique, and deep reverence for creativity, Berger makes the case that Sin City might just be the most accessible art city in the world, if we’re willing to look beyond the slots and shows.

Aaron Berger is the Executive Director of The Neon Museum in Las Vegas, where he leads groundbreaking initiatives in arts, education, and accessibility. With over two decades of experience in museum leadership across the U.S., Berger is known for blending cultural storytelling with community impact. A passionate advocate for the arts, he believes
title: Why Las Vegas is a great city for…art? | Aaron Berger | TEDxLasVegas

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Jaspal Bindra, delivered a title that read almost like a mantra.
The phrasing reminded the room that ambition without self-awareness can feel like motion without direction and that meaning often begins with inner work.
 Jaspal is a disciplined entrepreneur and a creative force behind some of the famous brands of North Bengal like Punjabi Kadhai , Cafe Kurseong Diaries , Baking Diaries and Karmaa Diaries - The first mindful cafe of the country . 
All of the restaurants lead by Jaspal are purpose driven instead of profit driven . He blends hospitality with story telling in a way that resonates with today’s audience . His journey shows resilience , compassionate leadership and a burning desire to create restaurant spaces as he strongly believes that restaurants are made to bond people , create community and not just serve food and beverage . This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.
title: If you don’t go within you, you go without you | Jaspal Bindra | TEDxInspiria Knowledge Campus

description:
Shivani Agarwala - India’s first and only 6-time Woman World Champion in Kettlebell Sports, also a Chartered Accountant and National Faculty for Indirect Taxation for ICAI.
Her title reinforced a powerful idea: wellness is not luck or discovery it’s construction. It’s created through habits, discipline, and consistency something that resonates strongly with students and professionals alike. Shivani Shah is a Chartered Accountant with over two decades of expertise in indirect taxation. Known for her mastery in GST compliance, litigation support, and strategic planning, she serves as a National Faculty for ICAI and has trained CBEC officials through NACEN. She is the Vice President of the Association of Corporate Advisers and Executives and holds key positions across Chambers of Commerce, professional Associations, and Study Circles nationwide. Recognised among ICAI’s Top 40 Finfluencers, she also chairs the Women’s Committee of EIRC ICAI.

title: Wellness is built, not found | Shivani Agarwalla | TEDxInspiria Knowledge Campus

In a world where wellness is often marketed as something you can buy, this talk title challenged consumer definitions and hinted at something deeper: wellness as an inner environment, a way of being, and a relationship with life.
 Sasha Sharma is a media entrepreneur, wellness advocate, and storyteller redefining how India experiences lifestyle and culture.

over 40K+ engaged subscribers across YouTube and over 13K followers on Instagram.

title: Sasha Sharma - Wellness is a place not a product | Sasha Sharma | TEDxInspiria Knowledge Campus

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Kamal Agarwala a Sales Trainer & Coach delivered a talk centered on one of the most universal conflicts: the one we have with ourselves.
You Vs You reframed success as something that often begins in the mind through clarity, self-talk, and the ability to negotiate with fear, doubt, and distraction. Kamal Agarwala is the Founder & CEO of Exactlly Software, building enterprise ERP, HRMS, and CRM products since 1997. A committed ecosystem enabler, he has spent over two decades mentoring founders and strengthening India’s startup ecosystem through leadership roles with NASSCOM and TiE, and currently serves on the TiE Global Board of Trustees. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: You Vs You - The Negotiator in your Head | Kamal Agarwala | TEDxInspiria Knowledge Campus

description:
The first featured talk came from Alkesh Agarwal—Cofounder & CEO at Re-feel, Partner at Seeders.in, an investor in SMEs & startups, and the author of Live Evil.
With a title that immediately sparked curiosity, the talk pointed toward a truth many people relate to: what we avoid doesn’t disappear—it influences our choices, patterns, and performance. It set a strong foundation for the day by making personal growth feel urgent, practical, and relevant to work and life.
 Alkesh Agarwal is an entrepreneur and author, known for building and scaling businesses across multiple industries in India. His entrepreneurial journey began early when he started selling denim while still in school, sparking a path shaped by curiosity, risk, and self-belief.

title: How unresolved challenges shape us | Alkesh Agarwal | TEDxInspiria Knowledge Campus

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Lokesh Nathany (Sales Trainer & Coach) explored a theme that’s becoming increasingly relevant in many families: caregiving, aging, and empathy across generations.
The title suggested tenderness and responsibility—how roles evolve, and how love sometimes means learning to lead with patience.
 Lokesh Nathany is a Sales Trainer, Coach, Motivational Speaker, and TEDx Speaker who blends 25 years of corporate leadership with the art of storytelling. Having led sales and business development across India and the Middle East for brands like HDFC, Franklin Templeton, ICICI, and Motilal Oswal, he is known for driving growth while building deep trust with teams and clients. Recognized among the 100 Most Impactful L&D Minds and 50 Most Innovative Storytellers by the World HRD Congress, Lokesh has conducted 500+ sessions, inspiring thousands toward sales excellence and personal transformation. title: Parenting the Parents: The Beautiful Role Reversal | Lokesh Nathany | TEDxInspiria Knowledge Campus

author: TEDx Talks
description:
L’intelligence artificielle peut recruter 130 000 personnes par an… et pourtant, elle peut aussi briser une trajectoire humaine en une seule phrase. À travers des histoires réelles de candidats, Thibaut Watrigant montre pourquoi, dans le recrutement, le vrai défi de l’IA n’est pas d’être plus intelligente… mais plus humaine. Et surtout : comment construire un futur où l’humain montre la direction à l’IA. Thibaut Watrigant est Product Director, AI chez Gojob (Next40), une scale-up française de la JobTech. Il conçoit des produits basés sur l’IA et les LLMs appliqués à un sujet profondément humain : l’accès à l’emploi.
Ancien consultant en stratégie (eleven strategy), diplômé de l’École polytechnique et de HEC Paris, il explore comment construire des intelligences artificielles utiles, responsables et profondément humaines. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Le rôle oublié de l’humanité à l’ère de l’IA | Thibaut Watrigant | TEDxIAE Aix Marseille

Autrice, sophrologue et fondatrice du podcast Elles Agissent, Émilie Berthet explore les chemins de la transformation individuelle et collective à travers la voix.

À la croisée du corps, des émotions et de l’engagement, elle accompagne celles et ceux qui osent se réinventer. Avec une parole ancrée, elle interroge ce que signifie agir, réparer, transmettre. Elle est la fondatrice de Elles Agissent, un podcast narratif, à la croisée de la voix, de la transmission et de l'impact. 

Nommée parmi les 40 Femmes Forbes France 2025, elle incarne une vision moderne de l'action : sensible, ancrée et utile. Sophrologue de formation, elle conçoit des outils pédagogiques comme J'explore mes émotions, forme les professionnels à la sophrologie ludique et intervient en entreprise sur les enjeux de santé mentale, d'intelligence émotionnelle et de leadership par le récit. 
Elle écrit pour Forbes France, Les Louves et Sophrologie Magazine, où elle explore les liens entre narration, engagement, parental
title: Et si l’on se trompait de modèle d’inspiration ? | Emilie BERTHET | TEDxPanthéonSorbonne

description:
Christophe Laquieze est écrivain, essayiste et éditorialiste pour des médias tels que Marianne et Bastille. Il se consacre à un combat central : réconcilier la littérature avec le domaine public, en particulier auprès des jeunes générations. Fondateur d’une communauté littéraire rassemblant plus d’un million de personnes sur les réseaux sociaux, il œuvre à rendre la lecture vivante, accessible et profondément ancrée dans les enjeux contemporains.

Spécialiste de la littérature sud-américaine, qu’il explore avec rigueur et passion, il interroge le pouvoir des récits dans la formation des imaginaires collectifs. Auteur de trois essais, il publiera en janvier 2026 son premier roman aux éditions J.C.Lattès, poursuivant ainsi son travail d’exploration littéraire entre engagement, exigence stylistique et transmission. title: Écrivain et chroniqueur littéraire | Christopher LAQUIEZE | TEDxPanthéonSorbonne

Aurélien de Meaux, entrepreneur et PDG d’Electra, est intervenu sur la scène du TEDxPanthéonSorbonne en septembre 2025 pour partager son parcours et sa vision de la mobilité durable.

Un talk inspirant sur l’innovation, l’entrepreneuriat et la manière de transformer des idées en projets concrets à grande échelle. Il est entrepreneur et cofondateur d'Electra, un acteur de référence dans les infrastructures de recharge ultra- rapide pour véhicules électriques en Europe. 
Lancée en 2020, l'entreprise connaît une croissance fulgurante : plus de 360 stations actives et plus de 600 millions d'€ levés pour déployer 15 000 points de charge d'ici 2030.

title: Quand la technologie rencontre l'écologie | Aurélien DE MEAUX | TEDxPanthéonSorbonne

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In this powerful and deeply personal talk, Sana Rathi reexamines one of humanity’s oldest myths — the story of Icarus, long remembered only as a warning against ambition. She offers a bold reinterpretation: before Icarus fell, he flew — and in that flight was a freedom most people never allow themselves to experience.

Blending psychology, mythology, and a raw story from her journey in Grindelwald, the talk explores how society gradually trims our wings, urging us to stay cautious and predictable. It challenges the belief that big dreams are dangerous and instead asks what becomes possible when the instinct to rise is trusted.

This is an invitation to rethink fear and ambition — and a reminder that falling is not failure; it is part of flight. Sana Rathi is the founder and visionary behind Earth’s 911, an NGO dedicated to societal and environmental conservation. title: The Middle Is Not Where Life Happens | Sana Rathi | TEDxFountainhead School

author: TEDx Talks
description: A six-year journey of self-discovery led to finding a true passion for chess. The experience captures the highs and lows of a chess player — from winning and dominating competitions to reflecting on mistakes and choosing growth over a fixed mindset. I am a passionate public speaker as I like to talk and share my ideas, I play chess, study science, and I am a coder. I evolved myself from being an introvert to becoming an extrovert, this became a pivot for me as I started to express my ideas and thoughts more freely. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Unmasking the fear of failure | Parth Baraiya | TEDxFountainhead School

author: TEDx Talks
description:
How many of us have been told to “focus” — to choose one path, one identity, one clear version of ourselves?

In this talk, Naisha Dalal challenges the belief that success requires narrowing who we are. Drawing from her experiences in classical dance, music, mathematics, and science, she explores what happens when curiosity refuses to fit into a single column.

The talk revisits a phrase long misunderstood: “Jack of all trades, master of none.” Perhaps the problem is not doing too much, but standing too close to see how it all connects.

This is not a rejection of focus, but a redefinition of it — an invitation to stop compressing oneself into something easier to explain and start recognizing the full spectrum of who one can be. Naisha Dalal is a Grade 11 student whose interests span classical dance, music, mathematics, science and literature. title: Jack of all Trades, Master of None! | Naisha Dalal | TEDxFountainhead School

author: TEDx Talks
description: In her talk, “Art Isn’t Where I Go When I’m Broken. I Go There When I’m My Most,” Mysha challenges the belief that art only emerges from pain. Instead, the talk shows how creativity often becomes strongest in moments of confidence, clarity, and self-awareness. It invites the audience to rethink why we create — not to fix ourselves, but to express the fullest version of who we are. Mysha Baxi is a grade 8 student at Fountainhead School and a young creative who believes art is not a place of escape, but a place of strength. Through her journey in the visual arts, she explores identity, growth, and self-expression. As a TEDx speaker, she challenges common ideas about creativity and encourages young people to see art as a space where they feel most powerful, confident, and whole. Her work reflects honesty, courage, and a deep belief in the value of creative expression. title: Art Is Where I’m Most Me | Mysha Baxi | TEDxFountainhead School
